method: OpenCV SIFT, bidirectional mutual Lowe ratio, fundamental/essential RANSAC
best_selection: largest F-RANSAC inlier count, then largest mutual ratio match count
caveat: Pairwise feature matching and pose diagnostics are not an end-to-end SfM reconstruction. NeRF uses calibrated synthetic cameras.

pairs.coordinate_convention: original-image pixels, x right and y down, x2.T F x1 = 0

calibrated_diagnostic.note: Known Blender camera diagnostic only; does not establish estimated SfM poses.

relative_pose_diagnostic.note: Two-view estimate only, susceptible to planar/low-parallax degeneracy; not bundle-adjusted SfM.
